preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the BST must be between 1 and 10,000.
The root of the BST must not be None.

postconditions.expression: all(node.value == sum(greater_nodes) for node in nodes)
postconditions.description: Each node's value must be equal to the sum of all nodes greater than itself.
The output must be the inorder traversal of the transformed BST.
